objective.name: test.echo
objective.description: Test tool: answers immediately with the parameters it received and records the call.

#root.role: Answer immediately with the received parameters and record the invocation.

transformation_contract.morphing: A set of parameters becomes the same parameters echoed back with the rank of the call.
invariants: The invocation is always recorded, whatever the parameters.
The call_index is the 1-based rank of the call among all recorded calls of this tool.
success: The response carries the echoed payload and the call rank.
notes: Executed by the test_tools Python wrapper. Test infrastructure only: it carries no business logic and exists to exercise the agentic mechanics.

effects.tool_calls: Appends one entry describing the call to the tool_calls matter.
